# SR-39802 decision: out of scope (Acme Industrial Supply Co. has no support agreement)

SR-39802 is out of scope. The ticket belongs to a different company from the Platinum-plan Acme, so no targets apply, nothing can be breached and no credit is owed. Two Northstar actions are owed: notify Zachary Brown (the account owner) and send a written decline of the credit claim. Both deadlines have now passed, and the record shows neither was done.

## 1. The customer

The ticket is on CRM account **CRM-2091**, Acme Industrial Supply Co. of Akron, OH.
- Its ERP customer is C-1044.
- Its DUNS number is 09-552-1187.

The Platinum terms (SUP-ACME-C) belong to a different company, **Acme Mfg. Holdings**: CRM-2048, ERP C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730, Milwaukee. The customer's statement "We're Acme. We have the Acme Platinum support plan" matches only by name. The procedure forbids identifying a customer by name alone.

## 2. Scope

None of the registered support terms (SUP-ACME-C, SUP-BRL-2025, SUP-CHS-2025) covers CRM-2091, C-1044 or DUNS 09-552-1187. The ticket is therefore out of scope, and Northstar handles it on a best-effort basis under SOP-SUPPORT-007.

The copy of Schedule C on file says coverage "includes Acme Mfg. Holdings and its operating locations." That copy differs from the registered terms, for example by listing NS-Cloud. It is not an approved governing document. Even if it were, it would cover Acme Mfg. Holdings' own locations, not a separate company.

## 3. True severity: Severity 1, for internal priority only

The recorded impact meets Severity 1(a):
- All NS-Edge gateways are offline.
- Conveyor monitoring is dark.
- Picking at the distribution center has halted.
- There is no workaround.

Because the ticket is out of scope, this classification sets internal priority only. No clock, targets, credits or Severity 1 escalations apply.

## 4–6. Schedule, clocks and measurement

- **Schedule version:** v2.0. The ticket opened 2026-08-10 06:05 EDT, which is 05:05 CDT.
- **Response and restoration:** not applicable.
- **Record of events:** an engineer phoned at 06:40 CDT, and service was restored at 13:20 CDT. Neither event is measured against any target.

## 7. Credits

**No credit is owed.** The customer's claim, received 2026-08-14 at 09:00 CDT, asked for a "Severity 1 restoration credit under Acme's Platinum plan." It must be declined.

## 8. Obligations

**What Northstar owes:**

| Duty | Role | Holder | Latest time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notify the account owner of CRM-2091 that an out-of-scope ticket was opened | Account owner | Zachary Brown | 2026-08-10 18:00 CDT (10 business hours after the 05:05 open; the clock starts at 08:00 Monday, a business day) |
| Send a written decision declining the claim, with the reason | Director of Customer Support | Marcus Adeyemi | 2026-09-13 (the 30th calendar day after receipt on 2026-08-14) |
| Issue a credit memo | Support Billing Manager | — | None, because no credit is approved |
| Record a root-cause finding | Support Engineering Lead | — | None, because no exclusion was asserted |

The record contains no evidence that either the notification or the decision was sent. Both deadlines had passed as of today, 2026-10-05.

**What the customer must do:** nothing, because no support terms apply. No telephone-reporting or claim requirement governs this ticket. For the record, Amy Barrett did report by phone, and she submitted a written claim, which will be declined.
